After the craving (script[3]-[5]) the chat works through one block per friend: Mina asks Cyrus if it works and Cyrus asks what he should know, peanut (script[6]-[11]); then Liam turns to Mina, vegetarian (script[12]-[16]); then Brooke, healthy (script[17]-[19]). levels.cyrus_lecture: Mild. script[10] is Cyrus explaining his own caution ('on the counter or tucked away in the back ... The far end of the counter isn't far enough'). No trap needs that precision: Banyan Kitchen's review is peanuts everywhere.

Each need gets an agreement echo (script[9], script[14], script[19]), and the chat has no story beat or news to carry the needs. Trimming alone still leaves the middle as back-to-back need blocks, so it needs a light rewrite, not just cuts.

overall.recommendation: No campaign-wide rework. Only level_12 merits one: like level_13, it's a sequence of one-need-per-friend blocks with almost no non-need talk, so it needs a light rewrite that adds 2-3 lines of banter between the blocks. level_04, level_05, level_07, level_09 and level_11 are fine with one- or two-line hand edits (cuts plus a merge or a small wording fix so the neighbouring lines still connect). Best value among those: level_09 (a three-line trip_fund stack in the chapter 2 beat level) and level_07 (the plate-of-fries Q&A). level_05 is the lowest priority. Leave level_01, level_02, level_03 and level_06: 01-02 are the tutorial, 03 is a natural two-person chat that carries the plate_of_fries origin, and level_06's apparent echo ('i'll guard your plate') is needed for its Banyan Kitchen fail line.
overall.after_edits: Each edit changes an approved level's dialogue, so rerun the Validator and the critic per level. For level_12 (rework) also run a blind playtest round. None of the proposals removes a callback's first-appearance line (satay_incident level_01 script[5], trip_fund level_02 script[7], plate_of_fries level_03 script[9], milkshake_incident level_06 script[11]), the noodle-stall setup (level_07 script[9]), the Cyrus beat (level_09 script[6]-[9]) or the Night Market beat (level_11 script[0]-[1]). I checked every outcome line that refers to a chat line, and the lines they refer to stay.
overall.rule_status: No level breaks a current brief rule: the clutter and Cyrus rules apply from level_18 on. These are feel improvements and Gabriella's call.
